title: item5：中文在 BINARY 排序下是否等于拼音序

steps.label: 写入中文值 张三（同时写 varchar(24) 列）
写入中文值 李四（同时写 varchar(24) 列）
写入中文值 王五（同时写 varchar(24) 列）
默认排序 ORDER BY name（无 COLLATE，即 BINARY）
steps.sql: SELECT cid, name FROM probe_cn ORDER BY name

steps.label: 显式 ORDER BY name COLLATE BINARY
steps.sql: SELECT cid, name FROM probe_cn ORDER BY name COLLATE BINARY

steps.label: ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE（是否影响中文）
steps.sql: SELECT cid, name FROM probe_cn ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE

steps.label: ORDER BY name DESC
steps.sql: SELECT cid, name FROM probe_cn ORDER BY name DESC

steps.label: 字节层面证据：UTF-8 十六进制与码点
steps.sql: SELECT cid, name, hex(name) AS utf8_hex, unicode(substr(name,1,1)) AS first_codepoint FROM probe_cn ORDER BY name

steps.label: 尝试拼音排序规则 COLLATE PINYIN（预期：无此排序规则）
steps.sql: SELECT cid, name FROM probe_cn ORDER BY name COLLATE PINYIN
steps.error: D1_ERROR: no such collation sequence: PINYIN: SQLITE_ERROR (extended: SQLITE_ERROR_MISSING_COLLSEQ)

steps.label: 尝试 COLLATE ICALLBACK，即 COLLATE zh（预期：无此排序规则）
steps.sql: SELECT cid, name FROM probe_cn ORDER BY name COLLATE zh
steps.error: D1_ERROR: no such collation sequence: zh: SQLITE_ERROR (extended: SQLITE_ERROR_MISSING_COLLSEQ)

steps.label: 中文值在 varchar(24) 列的字符数/字节数
steps.sql: SELECT cid, name, length(name) AS chars, length(cast(name AS blob)) AS bytes FROM probe_cn ORDER BY cid
